advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test exercising _recall_summary over a small synthetic rows/culprits set, asserting exact recall/escalation_rate values for size, repeat-fix, and union predicates.
evidence: search of tests/ for 'backtest_bugfix_size', '_recall_summary', and 'check-planning-corpus' returns (no matches) — the script is entirely untested

scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py adds `_recall_summary` with `"recall": round(len(caught) / len(labelled), 4) if labelled else 0.0` and a `union` predicate `lambda r: bool(r['flagged']) or bool(r.get('repeat_fix'))`
commit message: 'the repeat-fix signal recalls 12 of 24 later-culprit fixes where the floor recalls 10' — the acceptance basis is produced by this arithmetic
advisory.finding: The backtest script's new recall/escalation arithmetic (_recall_summary computing recall=caught/labelled, escalation_rate, and the size/repeat-fix/union predicates) plus _commit_time, _caused_by_culprits, _print_recall and the --repeat-fix/--labels-from-caused-by CLI paths have no test coverage; a defect in this arithmetic would silently misreport the recall comparison that is the stated empirical basis for the entire change.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Forward request.base (and reconcile head) into apply_bugfix_size_gate so the repeat-fix walk's base_ref matches the diff's actual base rather than a hardcoded HEAD~1.
evidence: finalize.py:347 `_bugfix_size.apply_bugfix_size_gate(verdict, diff_text=prep.dc.diff_text, commit_message=..., repo_root=request.repo_root)` — request.base is not passed
gate_dispatch.py:335 `base: str = "HEAD~1"` on CodeReviewRequest (configurable; assemble.py:197 and llm.py:61 expose --base)
bugfix_size_gate.py:373 `non_test, reason, priors = escalation_for_diff(diff_text or "", repo_root=repo_root)` — base_ref defaults to HEAD~1, never wired to request.base
bugfix_size_gate.py:283 comment: 'assemble builds the review diff as HEAD~1..HEAD' — true only for the default base
dropped.finding: The bugfix-size gate hardcodes base_ref='HEAD~1' for the repeat-fix walk but does not receive the review's actual base ref (request.base). When a code review runs against a non-default base (--base is configurable, e.g. origin/main for a multi-commit push), the diff spans request.base..HEAD while the repeat-fix walk anchors at HEAD~1; intermediate commits of the change under review (between request.base and HEAD~1) are then walked as 'prior' bug fixes, re-introducing the self-counting the HEAD~1 anchor was designed to prevent.
scenarios: A bug-fix branch of 3 commits reviewed with --base origin/main: the two earlier commits of the same series touch the same file and are counted as prior repeat fixes, escalating the change on its own commits.
dropped.suggested_fix: Add a base_ref parameter to apply_bugfix_size_gate and pass request.base from finalize.py; thread it into escalation_for_diff/_repeat_fix_verdict instead of relying on the HEAD~1 default.
